intelligence.essence: A composer proven six out of six through URL suffixes was never proven through the menu — and the menu path was dead. ADD → Create menu → "Message" did nothing on tap: the menu item only adds a class to a panel that was never built. Every entry point is its own proof; proving one entry proves nothing about the others.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a house with six doors, sweetheart — you checked all six doors by opening them from the outside with a special key, and they all worked! But nobody ever tried the doorknob from the inside — and when someone finally did, that doorknob just spun around and the door stayed shut! So we check every door the way a person really opens it, sweetheart — not just the special key way!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the checker proved the composer six ways by typing the address straight in, dear, and it worked every time. But nobody tapped the Message button in the menu itself, love — and when the eye finally did, nothing happened at all, dear. The button only flipped a switch for a little room that was never built. So we test the button the way a person taps it, love — the address and the button are two different doors, and each one needs its own knock.
